models.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Diarization
models.credit:
Nemotron 3 Diarization by NVIDIA (https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Nemotron-3-Diarization), licensed under the OpenMDW License Agreement, version 1.1.
Converted to Core ML (modified) by Fluid Inference.

models.name: pyannote Community-1, WeSpeaker and BUT PLDA

use.en: Speaker voices and fallback speaker detection

models.credit:
Speaker segmentation and WeSpeaker speaker embedding from pyannote speaker-diarization-community-1 by pyannote (https://huggingface.co/pyannote/speaker-diarization-community-1).
PLDA parameters by BUT Speech@FIT. Copyright (c) Brno University of Technology / BUT Speech@FIT.
Converted to Core ML (modified) by Fluid Inference.
Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

Citations:
Alexis Plaquet and Hervé Bredin. Powerset multi-class cross entropy loss for neural speaker diarization. Proc. INTERSPEECH 2023.

Hongji Wang, Chengdong Liang, Shuai Wang, Zhengyang Chen, Binbin Zhang, Xu Xiang, Yanlei Deng and Yanmin Qian. Wespeaker: A research and production oriented speaker embedding learning toolkit. ICASSP 2023, IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP), pp. 1–5. IEEE, 2023.

Federico Landini, Ján Profant, Mireia Diez and Lukáš Burget. Bayesian HMM clustering of x-vector sequences (VBx) in speaker diarization: theory, implementation and analysis on standard tasks. Computer Speech & Language, 2022.

models.name: LS-EEND
models.credit:
Copyright (c) 2023 Audio-WestlakeU
LS-EEND by Di Liang and Xiaofei Li (Westlake University), https://github.com/Audio-WestlakeU/FS-EEND.
Converted to Core ML by GradientDescent2718, published by Fluid Inference.

Citation:
Di Liang and Xiaofei Li. LS-EEND: Long-Form Streaming End-to-End Neural Diarization With Online Attractor Extraction. IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech and Language Processing, vol. 33, pp. 3568–3581, 2025.

models.name: Parakeet Ultra

Converted to Core ML with int8 encoder weights (modified) by Fluid Inference.
